idea.title: The Australian Army Lost a War to Emus
idea.question: How did a flock of birds beat soldiers with machine guns?
idea.hook: In 1932, Australia sent machine guns after birds.
idea.payoff: The emus split into small groups and soaked up bullets like tanks: about 10 rounds per kill.
idea.why_visual: Soldiers, trucks and machine guns against a goofy army of emus in a wheat field.
visual_metaphors: an emu in a tiny helmet
a scoreboard of bullets vs birds
